outboundMessages.description: Notify QAC webstie on all the flight records related to agency service request created or updated in salesforce including the onces which is coming from the website itself
outboundMessages.name: QAC Flight Notification

rules.description: Send outbound messages to QCP queue whenver a flight record relevant to agency related service request is created or updated
rules.formula: AND( Case__r.RecordType.Name = "Service Request", RecordType.Name = "Service Request", ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Account.Type, "Agency Account"), NOT(ISBLANK(Case__r.Account.Qantas_Industry_Centre_ID__c)), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Type, "Group Waivers"),ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Type, "SBT"),ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Type, "Service Request"), ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Type, "Commerical Waiver (non BART)"), CONTAINS( TEXT(Case__r.Problem_Type__c) , "Internal") ) ) )
